_status: DRAFT — placeholders marked; every number here is read by the page, none are inline
_default_size: The wall a design opens on, in modules (Fable blind read 2026-11-03, Burak approved): chosen by the design on its first pick (unless the architect typed a wall) and for a code-less open. Glissando is modelled as 600 x 600 halves top/bottom, so 2 x 4 modules = 2 plates wide x 2 plates high (1.2 x 2.4 m, whole lay period). A design not listed keeps its gallery plan (plans) or 8 x 4 (bond / corners); Hemiola and Fugato are fixed plans and never read this. A share code carries its own cols/rows and ignores it. default_code follows the Accelerando default (6 x 4).
_designs: The Studio Designs the picker offers, in order (alphabetical by public name: Accelerando OPT, Andante AND, Antiphon ANT, Fioritura FIO, Fugato L093, Glissando GLI, Gruppetto CRE, Hemiola SKW, Hocket HOC, Melisma ROT, Mezzavoce MEZ, Ricercar RIC, Rondeau DSH, Sonado SON). A design with no baked kit is skipped. SKW (Hemiola) is a face preview: its kit is the front face of the Skew r8 screen as a height field, and every place it is named says so (strings preview_label). Fugato keeps its first code L093 (Library 093 cove-course) so old codes still open it. Kits not listed here (plates_r3, throat_r2) are hidden from the picker; their files stay, and an old code for one opens the default wall.
_finishes_held: Burak 2026-11-13: only paint-ready (Canvas) is offered for now. Veil / Grit wait here; move them back into finishes to offer them again. The test fixture serves them, so the finish-switching paths stay tested.
_finishes: The surface choice (Burak 2026-10-26): Canvas = paint-ready, Veil / Grit = finished (artisan finishes). Only these three are offered. Pigment colours are on hold. The composition code's tag slot (comp.colour) now carries the finish id. swatch = the one neutral on-screen tone for every finish: the preview shows no finish and no pigment.
